name: Grieving For Parent
overview: Scripture acknowledges the deep pain of grieving, especially in the loss of a parent, assuring believers that God is near to the brokenhearted and saves those with a contrite spirit. The psalmist reminds us that though our flesh and heart may fail, God remains our enduring strength and refuge. God tenderly heals and binds the wounds of those who mourn, promising comfort to the sorrowful and a future where all tears, pain, and death will be no more. This hope anchors the believer in Christ-centered consolation amid the sorrow of loss.
